cases.title: Average of an empty list
cases.description: average(values) raises ZeroDivisionError for an empty list. Return 0.0 for empty input while preserving the normal arithmetic mean for non-empty numeric lists.

cases.title: Palindrome normalization
cases.description: is_palindrome(text) compares raw characters. It should ignore letter case and non-alphanumeric characters while retaining the existing boolean result for ordinary strings.

cases.title: Clamp lower bound
cases.description: clamp(value, lower, upper) enforces only the upper bound. It must constrain values below lower as well as above upper, leaving values inside the interval unchanged.
